findings: Inspected the full-frame contact sheet and both original/overlay target-crop sheets for these nine actual source frames. Head, torso, arms and visible legs remain covered across those pose changes; the held cube, round table, tripods and curtain background remain excluded. No identity switch, broad background takeover, empty target localization or major visible-body omission was observed in the sampled frames.
